facts.value: Graduates of this course will be able to understand and apply mathematical and statistical techniques to gain insight into the physical and economic world.
If you like mathematics and economics, and like to question what underlies the physical and economic world around you, then this may well be the course for you.

The aim of this degree is to equip the mathematically competent students with a more specialised focus at the level of mathematical theory and statistical analysis, while simultaneously providing them with an exposure to the principles of economics and its key applications.
Bachelor of Science in Economics and Mathematics
The course is ideally split almost 50-50 between maths and economics.
